title: LTX 2.3 foley - wire the proven bench workflow into the app as a Flow
description: Bench-proven full-clip V2V foley (comfy_workflows/raw/ltx_v2v_foley_template.json, 53 nodes, sha e947b371e3611748) runs end to end and the user approved the audio. Ships as a FLOW, not a model op - no ModelDef, no dep entries, /mpi-add-flow. BLOCKED on MPI-531: FlowStepField is select|button|toggle only, so authoring this Flow today means a new JS uiComponent that MPI-531 item 4 would then have to port. Also owns the foley-vs-voice mode decision that MPI-520 was wrongly carrying. See MPI-4 brief/validation.
